title: Personal website and web developer portfolio

meta.description: Nikolas Malík, a self-taught web developer from Czechia. Portfolio of websites and web apps built with Node.js, Express, MongoDB and modern frontend tools.

about.title: About
about.text: Hello, my name is Nikolas Malík and I create web applications and websites as a hobby. I have been doing this for a few years now and I am always looking for new challenges and opportunities to learn and grow as a developer. I am passionate about web development and I am always looking for new ways to improve my skills and knowledge in this field. I am also interested in other areas of technology and I am always looking for new ways to expand my knowledge and skills in these areas as well. I am a self-taught developer and I have learned everything I know through online resources, tutorials, and practice. I am always looking for new opportunities to learn and grow as a developer and I am excited to see where my journey takes me in the future.
about.text2: Besides that, I like spending time in nature with my dog. I enjoy physical activity, to some extent. I also like learning new things and trying new things, even if I don't always feel like it.
